# Requirements traceability matrix

Generated from both authoritative specifications by `npm run requirements:generate`. 480 source requirements/scenarios retained. Original wording and priorities remain in the register. Mapping is progressive: pending cells are unresolved implementation work, never a completed design. Full source sections remain binding, including prose requirements without IDs. Evidence is MOCK unless explicitly stated otherwise.
